name: Skaab Ruinator
oracle_text:
As an additional cost to cast this spell, exile three creature cards from your graveyard.
Flying
You may cast this card from your graveyard.
blocked_sentences: As an additional cost to cast this spell, exile three creature cards from your graveyard.

needs.what: The card itself is expressible: keywords [flying], additional_cost {"exile_from_graveyard": {"types": ["Creature"], "count": 3}}, and a static {"effect": "cast_from_graveyard", "active_zones": ["graveyard"], "affects_player": "you", "text": "You may cast this card from your graveyard."}. What is missing is a verification sandbox that can cast it: build_sandbox (cards/authoring/verify.py) puts only two creature cards in your graveyard (OWN_GRAVEYARD_ROLES), so an additional cost exiling N creature cards from the graveyard with N > 2 is never payable and gate 4 rejects the card as 'not playable in the sandbox'. Needs graveyard fodder scaled to additional_cost.exile_from_graveyard.count, the way spare_cards_in_hand scales spare Forests to additional_cost.discard.
needs.why_existing_wont_do: Verified with author_cards.py --collect --dry-run: the answer above loads and is rejected only at the playable gate (offered just Pass/Play land). spare_cards_in_hand covers discard additional costs only; nothing adds graveyard creature cards for an exile_from_graveyard additional cost.
